title: trim_text: trim whitespace in one text column
description: Remove leading and trailing whitespace from a single text column. Optionally collapse repeated whitespace inside the value into one space.

parameters.name: column
parameters.description: The text column to clean. Must exist in the dataset.

parameters.name: collapse_whitespace
parameters.description: When true, replace repeated whitespace inside the text with a single space.

rag_note: Use trim_text for low-risk whitespace cleanup on one column. Do not use it for regex replacement or multi-column parsing.
